metadata.description: Five-item global measure of cognitive life satisfaction.
metadata.intended_use: Wellbeing research, social-care evaluation, health research, and population surveys.
metadata.name_origin: Satisfaction With Life Scale, abbreviated SWLS.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a brief global judgement of satisfaction with one's life rather than a measure of affect alone.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Global cognitive evaluation complements symptom and domain-specific wellbeing measures.
metadata.interpretation_notes: It measures perceived life satisfaction, not objective living conditions or clinical wellbeing; German translation evidence and permission remain version-specific.

versions.source_citation: Diener et al. (1985). The Satisfaction With Life Scale.

source_documents.title: Satisfaction With Life Scale source publication
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact German edition and reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.

cosmin_metrics.internal_consistency: Cronbach's alpha ca. .87, Test-Retest-Reliabilität (2 Monate) ca. .82 in der Originalstudie.
cosmin_metrics.source: Diener E, Emmons RA, Larsen RJ, Griffin S (1985). The Satisfaction with Life Scale. J Pers Assess, 49(1), 71-75.

versions.scoring_notes: Fünf Items werden zum globalen Lebenszufriedenheitsscore summiert; keine klinische Diagnose.
versions.psychometric_summary: SWLS ist international sehr häufig eingesetzt; deutsche Norm- und Übersetzungsevidenz ist versionsabhängig.
